limitations: PMTiles has named site/room information points and bridge/paths, not surviving castle wall polygons. Wall plans are explicitly reconstructed from pictures.
Coarse viewer elevation smooths the gorge and terraces. Native Y=0 is the bridge-midpoint terrain datum; bridge/floor levels are approximate.
